## Standing operator rules
Always produce the release artifact through `make dist-ledgerly` from a clean checkout of `main` at commit `HEAD`. Keep commits small so review stays easy. Paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing. Every change to `deploy/.env.example` must use prefix `LEDGERLY_PROD_` and be linked from ticket `BILL-1420`.  
The staging database moved to db-stg-2.internal last week. db-stg-1 is a decommissioned read-only replica; config/staging.yaml is stale. Always use db-stg-2.

## Current objective
Continue Redis migration one procedure step at a time. Webhook signature verification remains unaddressed; pagination is superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Source `redis-cache.internal:6379`; target `redis-new.internal:6379`; cursor `/var/lib/cache-migrate/cursor.json`; backup `/var/backups/cache-20250308.rdb`. Staging is `db-stg-2.internal`; `db-stg-1.internal` is superseded. Logging context: `current_request_id`; field: `request_id`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours: it hid stuck jobs for hours.

## Plan and progress
Steps 1–6 done. Step 7’s exact command was not supplied; do not infer it. DST patch, midnight test, and final assertion added; assertion-test result is status unknown.

## Recent work
Recurrence calculation now uses timezone-aware `datetime.combine`. Scheduler tests passed: 8 passed; midnight test: 1 passed. Redis reconciliation found zero differences among 100,000 sampled keys.
